ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central black pigmentation field extending from the peduncle toward the notch. Significant black blotching on the inner-left lobe and outer-right lobe. Numerous low-density black speckles distributed across the white interstitial fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an interior angle of approximately 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration across the entire trailing edge; frequency of peaks increases towards the distal tips, which exhibit high-frequency jaggedness corresponding to barnacle attachment points.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal sweep trajectory; initial convex expansion from the notch followed by a slight concave taper towards the posterior-curved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast textured clusters of white/beige pixel groupings located at the extreme tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation fields, most notably on the upper-left lobe and mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization clusters at both distal tips; multiple linear scratch marks on the ventral surface pigmentation.
